items.protectedArea: Sítios de Importância Comunitária / Zonas Especiais de Conservação (SIC/ZEC, Habitats Directive 92/43/CEE) and Zonas de Proteção Especial (ZPE, Birds Directive 2009/147/CE) across mainland Portugal

items.dataSource: ICNF geoCATALOGO (geocatalogo.icnf.pt) and ICNF ArcGIS portal sig.icnf.pt provide SIC/ZEC and ZPE polygons via WMS/WFS (si.icnf.pt endpoints); also on SNIAmb (sniamb.apambiente.pt), SNIG/RNDG (snig.dgterritorio.gov.pt) and dados.gov.pt. Habitats layer = 'Habitats naturais e semi-Naturais - PSRN2000'.
items.notes: For the app, the authoritative national Rede Natura layers live in the ICNF geoCATALOGO / sig.icnf.pt ArcGIS services; these are the cleanest source for ZEC+ZPE boundaries.

summary: Complete inventory of protected-area special plans in mainland Portugal: 25 Planos de Ordenamento de Áreas Protegidas (POAP) — matching ICNF's stated count of '25 POAP em vigor'. Breakdown: 1 national park (Peneda-Gerês), 13 natural parks, 9 nature reserves, 2 national protected landscapes (Arriba Fóssil da Costa da Caparica, Serra do Açor). All POAP were approved by Resolução do Conselho de Ministros, mostly clustered in 2004–2011 (a large batch on 24 Nov 2008: RCM 175–183/2008). LEGAL TRANSITION: Law n.º 31/2014 (Lei de Bases) + RJIGT (DL n.º 80/2015) require every POAP (a 'plano especial') to be reconducted into a 'Programa Especial de Área Protegida' (PEAP/PGAP), whose content must then be transposed into municipal PDMs. As of mid-2026 only ONE PEAP is approved and em vigor: the Programa Especial do PN das Serras de Aire e Candeeiros (RCM n.º 104/2023 + DL n.º 76/2023). Three others are most advanced (ICNF, Aug 2025): Litoral Norte 'awaiting approval/publication', Peneda-Gerês in final version after Sep–Oct 2024 public discussion, Tejo Internacional heading to public discussion; the remaining ~17 were still in Phase II (preliminary proposal). Serra da Estrela was DROPPED from the conversion after the 2022 wildfires and is instead covered by a Programa de Revitalização. Until a PEAP is published, the corresponding POAP stays em vigor. CAVEATS to verify in DR: exact RCM number/date for PN Serra de São Mamede (search returned RCM 77/2005) and for the Arriba Fóssil da Costa da Caparica plan (placed at RCM 178/2008 within the 24-Nov-2008 cluster). Natural monuments (e.g. Portas de Ródão, Pegadas de Dinossáurios de Ourém/Torres Novas, Cabo Mondego, Carenque) generally have NO POAP. GIS data: POAP/PEAP boundaries and zoning live in the ICNF geoCATALOGO (geocatalogo.icnf.pt) and ICNF ArcGIS portal (sig.icnf.pt), plus SNIT/PCGT (pcgt.dgterritorio.gov.pt) for the programas especiais, and SNIG/RNDG + dados.gov.pt. Rede Natura 2000 (PSRN2000 sectoral plan — an overlay, NOT a plano especial) supplies SIC/ZEC (Habitats Directive) and ZPE (Birds Directive) polygons, also served from ICNF geoCATALOGO/sig.icnf.pt (WMS/WFS via si.icnf.pt) and SNIAmb (sniamb.apambiente.pt)."
